explication: SamGeo is a geospatial image-segmentation product exposed through a Python library, a Click CLI, a REST API, and a QGIS plugin. The main workflow is to supply imagery and prompts or select automatic segmentation, run a SAM-family model, then save or visualize raster/vector results. The graph also preserves documented tile download, text prompting, time-series/video, and plugin-installation capabilities. Some feature branches are documented but not fully sampled; those links are omitted rather than inferred from names alone.
